name: io.github.Lynn-hh/armguard-mcp
title: armguard-mcp
description: Safety-first MCP server for ROS 2 robot arms: server-side safety envelope, human approval, audit

packageArguments.name: --policy
packageArguments.description: Path to the safety policy YAML (see examples/policies/fr3.yaml). Read it before connecting a real robot.

packageArguments.name: --backend
packageArguments.description: Robot backend: 'fake' (simulated FR3, no ROS) or 'ros2' (needs a sourced ROS 2 environment).
